title: Edit the Arabic language
body:
Great and genuinely useful app, but the Arabic typography really needs attention. The current Arabic font looks outdated and doesn't match modern UI standards at all.

Please consider updating the Arabic interface font to a clean, modern typeface that’s easy on the eyes. Google Sans Arabic would be the most natural fit here, or modern alternatives like IBM Plex Sans Arabic or Cairo.

The current font takes away from the app's clean design. A refreshed Arabic font would make a huge difference in the overall user experience.

title: Simple but not sophisticated
body: I have been using the 'Tasks' app for the past three years, and I appreciate its simplicity and basic task management capabilities. However, there are a few additional features I hope the developers will consider. Specifically, I find value in features like calendar synchronization, the ability to make calls related to specific tasks (whether assigned to myself or a vendor), snooze functionality, contact synchronization, and task prioritization. Wishing the developers the best of luck!

title: The way I get things done from myself
body:
I am now an expert user of Google tasks. I get everything done with the help of this app. For each major area I set up a tasks list with an appropriate title, for example ‘Money Matters’ or ‘Bill Payments’. Then, tasks are created with the deadlines set.

I work independently; there is no boss. So, an extreme level of discipline is critical in everything I do. This app serves my ‘finger pointer’ that help me organize everything I have to do in one place. 

The app gets sync across all three digital devices I use. 

Google Tasks, Calendar, Drive and Google Meet represent my office, home, communication platform and all admin system. 

They all together create my the paperless virtual world that facilitate my ‘digital nomadic’ existence.
